study: Right-arm accelerometer forecasting during two kinds of walking
role: Independent motion-only NeuroTranslation reference study, separate from the multimodal general learner.
source: Billur Barshan and Kerem Altun, Daily and Sports Activities, UCI Machine Learning Repository, DOI 10.24432/C5C59F, CC BY 4.0.
units: Native right-arm sensor acceleration values. No gravity removal, frame alignment or certified physical-unit conversion.
window_rule: Each window stays inside its 5-second file; take t-15 through t inclusive; target row t+3. Never concatenate clips. Only right-arm XYZ in the sensor frame go to either fitted model; no task, subject or timestamp features.
standardization: Per-axis mean and population standard deviation across flattened TRAIN input windows only, float64 accumulation; use these for inputs and target. Stop for missing, nonfinite or constant axes.
ridge: 16x3 standardized input in time-major order; predict standardized displacement from last value, unpenalized intercept, minimize mean residual sum of squares per sample plus 0.001 times squared coefficient norm, float64.
transformer: Input linear 3 to 32, learned 16-position embedding initialized normal(sd=0.02), two pre-norm TransformerEncoderLayer blocks constructed independently, four heads, 64-unit GELU feedforward, dropout 0. Final history token through layer norm and zero-initialized linear 32 to 3, added to last normalized XYZ. Bidirectional attention only within already observed history.
training: CPU float32, seed 20261120, AdamW lr 0.001, betas 0.9/0.999, eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.01, MSE normalized XYZ. 12 epochs, seeded shuffled windows each epoch, batches of 64 including remainder; no early stopping, tuning, refit, or shuffling across held data. Select epoch 12 before assessment. Save and reload model state and verify output parity.
order_control: Use numpy default_rng(34117) with permutation(15) once per canonical assessment window in activity, person, segment, cutoff order. Jointly permute first 15 XYZ readings within that history, preserve last and target. Apply same shuffle to all three predictors. Report order sensitivity only.
primary_rule: Pass only if transformer mean absolute error averaged over all three axes and both activities is strictly smaller than both ridge and persistence for EACH assessment person. Ties fail. Report paired differences by person.
report: Report native-unit MAE total, person, activity, axis and person-by-activity, including negative results. The two people and repeated overlapping forecast/next-input time supports within a bout preclude independent-window population inference. Identification or decoding of nervous-system activity is outside the measurements.
